title: Buy a train ticket
description: Buy a ticket, ask about the platform, and check the departure time.
descriptionIt: Compra un biglietto, chiedi il binario e controlla l'orario di partenza.
setting: Ticket office at a busy train station. You need to travel to Florence today.
aiCharacter: Helpful ticket clerk named Anna. Speaks clearly and confirms details.
goals: Ask for a ticket to Florence
openingLine: Good morning! Where would you like to go today?
suggestedPhrases: I'd like a ticket to Florence, please.
What time does the train depart?
